description: This file defines the internal class GrainRuntime which implements the IGrainRuntime interface. It manages grain lifecycle operations such as deactivation, storage access, and context validation within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: GrainRuntime
classes.description: Implements the IGrainRuntime interface, providing methods for grain lifecycle management, storage access, and runtime context validation.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the specified grain context when it is idle, with a reason indicating application request.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of a grain context by a specified time span, if the context supports delay.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage for a specific grain state type associated with the given grain context.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates the grain context, throwing exceptions if the context is null or invalid.
